cs.t: I use a GPD Win Max 2 for this purpose ( https://fluctlight.net/gpd_win_max_2 ) and while it has its quirks, the performance of a Ryzen APU is significantly better than the Chuwi Minibook X. I think my desire for this kind of product is something lighter, but this set of notes on the Chuwi feels like the compromises GPD gives you but with less power.
cs.th: Chuwi Minibook X: the netbook we deserve

cs.t: Some AMD integrated GPUs are surprisingly fragile with this. I have a GPD Win Max 2 8840U (a "concept car" handheld laptop hybrid) and when I got it last year, it would fail to wake from suspend  and  hibernate about half the time  in Windows , with Linux actually being more reliable (but also not perfect), and only this year did an AMD GPU driver fix this.
cs.th: I helped fix sleep-wake hangs on Linux with AMD GPUs
